articles.title: Global Transport Emissions Rise in 2024
articles.summary: According to the latest reports, global transport emissions have risen by 3% in the first quarter of 2024, driven primarily by increased air travel and freight transport.

articles.title: New Electric Bus Fleet Launched in Major Cities
articles.summary: Several major cities worldwide have launched new electric bus fleets as part of their efforts to reduce urban air pollution and lower carbon footprints.

articles.title: Innovations in Sustainable Aviation Fuel
articles.summary: Researchers have made significant advancements in sustainable aviation fuel, which could reduce the carbon emissions of air travel by up to 80% compared to traditional jet fuels.

articles.title: Carbon Tax Policies Expanded in EU
articles.summary: EU governments have implemented new carbon tax policies to incentivize cleaner energy usage across industries.

articles.title: Renewable Energy Investment Hits Record High
articles.summary: Investments in renewable energy sources have hit a record high in 2024, signaling a major shift toward green energy.

articles.title: Urban Cycling Programs Reduce Emissions
articles.summary: Cities adopting large-scale urban cycling programs have seen measurable reductions in carbon emissions from daily commuting.
